overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: no evidence of deliberation outside a posted meeting, and the 2016 executive session minutes may stay withheld while their purpose continues.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board deliberated, in executive session or outside a posted meeting, on actions MassDOT procedure requires for the 591 Massachusetts Avenue road project.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find no evidence that the Board deliberated outside of a meeting in this respect.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a quorum of the Board attended a Tree Warden public hearing on the project, amounting to deliberation outside a posted meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Although a quorum of the Board was present at the Tree Warden hearing, we find no evidence of deliberation, as the Board members merely observed the hearing.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board improperly withholds minutes of a January 25, 2016 executive session held under the real property value purpose.
allegations.key_passage: We are satisfied that the Board’s discussions related to the value of real property and fell within a proper executive session purpose, and that the executive purpose remains ongoing.

allegations.summary: Complaint raised concerns about actions by town employees and staff, which the Open Meeting Law does not reach.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Open Meeting Law does not apply to individual employees, the allegations concerning town employees, even if true, would not constitute violations of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board did not allow sufficient public participation at its meetings about the project.
allegations.key_passage: The Open Meeting Law permits the chair of a public body to decide whether to allow for public participation, and if so, to set limitations on participation.

allegations.summary: Request for further review added allegations not included in the original complaint filed with the Board.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to review any additional allegations contained in the request for further review that were not included in the original complaints filed with the public body.
